Hechizo: agregás un Hechizo de Campo del: Spell: add a Field Spell from your Deck to your hand. Works as a searcher in many decks.
Hechizo: pagás 1000 LP e invocás de Fusi: Spell: pay 1000 LP and Fusion Summon a Level 5 or lower monster from your Extra Deck.
